assertions.name: lone-pair trace exceeds bond-pair trace (Δtr > 0 ⇒ angle narrows)
assertions.source: tr_M(e⁻) − tr_M(σ) = h z² > 0 for q > 1; correct VSEPR sign (reverses the |Φ₁| generator-count probe, which gave bond>lone)

assertions.name: Δtr equals the q-exact closed form h·z²
assertions.source: tr_M(e⁻)=h z²+z, tr_M(σ)=z; the excess is exactly the σ₀²=h σ₀+1 commutator weight that |·| discards

description: H₂O H–O–H angle shift via the Markov trace tr_M (owner correction: use the checked trace, not |Φ₁|, so the q-commutator structure is kept). Lone pair = intra-block electron pair e⁻ = σ₀σ₁σ₀ (tr_M = h z² + z); bond pair = cross-block O–H σ generator (tr_M = z). Δtr = h z² > 0 is the lone-pair trace excess that drives b > 0 ⇒ θ_min < θ₀ (angle narrows below tetrahedral). q-exact SIGN; magnitude left to the geometric angular stiffness a (not fitted).

data.finding: Switching the molecular sub-braid score from Φ₁=Σ log|v| to the Markov trace tr_M reverses the sign error of the prior H₂O probe. |v| is a generator-count sum (4-strand bond pair > 3-strand lone pair → wrong sign → angle opened ~140°); tr_M keeps the h z² commutator weight of the intra-block electron pair e⁻, giving tr_M(lone) − tr_M(bond) = h z² > 0 → b > 0 → θ_min < θ₀ (narrows, correct). q-exact sign + right order of magnitude (h z ≈ 10.4 % vs observed 4.5 %). The exact degrees need the geometric angular stiffness a; deliberately not fitted (formalize-first).
